io.milvus.v2.utils

Class ConvertUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.utils.ConvertUtils

  • public class ConvertUtils
extends Object
    Utility class providing conversion methods between Milvus gRPC protobuf types and the Milvus Java SDK v2 model types.

    Used internally by the SDK service implementations to translate query, search, aggregation, index, and collection responses.

      • toProtoDataType

        public static DataType toProtoDataType(DataType dt)
        Converts a SDK v2 data type to the corresponding gRPC DataType.
        Parameters:
        dt - the SDK v2 data type to convert, may be null
        Returns:
        the corresponding gRPC data type, or DataType.None if dt is null
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if the data type cannot be converted

      • toSdkDataType

        public static DataType toSdkDataType(DataType dt)

        the corresponding SDK v2 data type, or DataType.None if dt is null
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if the data type cannot be converted

      • getEntities

        public List<QueryResp.QueryResult> getEntities(QueryResults response)
        Converts a gRPC QueryResults response into a list of SDK v2 query results.

        Handles count(*) aggregation responses and element-level (struct-array) queries, where one entity is expanded into one result per matched element.

        Parameters:
        response - the gRPC query results response
        Returns:
        a list of SDK v2 query results
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if the element indices do not match the returned row count

      • getEntities

        public List<List<SearchResp.SearchResult>> getEntities(SearchResults response)
        Converts a gRPC SearchResults response into a list of search results grouped by query.

        Each inner list contains the search results for one query, including entity fields, score, primary key, ID, highlight results, and element offsets where applicable.

        Parameters:
        response - the gRPC search results response
        Returns:
        a list of search result lists, one per query

      • getAggregationBuckets

        public List<List<AggregationBucket>> getAggregationBuckets(SearchResults response)
        Converts a gRPC SearchResults aggregation response into a list of aggregation buckets grouped per query.

        When aggTopks is present, the flat bucket list is split into per-query groups according to each query's top-k value.

        Parameters:
        response - the gRPC search results response
        Returns:
        a list of aggregation bucket lists, one per query
        Throws:
        MilvusClientException - if aggregation buckets are returned without aggTopks for a multi-query search

      • convertToDescribeIndexResp

        public DescribeIndexResp convertToDescribeIndexResp(List<IndexDescription> response)
        Converts a list of gRPC IndexDescription responses into a single SDK v2 DescribeIndexResp.

        Parses the index parameters (index type, metric type, mmap settings, and extra parameters) from the gRPC key-value pairs.

        Parameters:
        response - the list of gRPC index descriptions
        Returns:
        the SDK v2 describe index response

      • convertDescCollectionResp

        public DescribeCollectionResp convertDescCollectionResp(DescribeCollectionResponse response)
        Converts a gRPC DescribeCollectionResponse into an SDK v2 DescribeCollectionResp.

        Maps the collection schema, vector field names, primary field name, consistency level, and other collection metadata to the SDK v2 model.

        Parameters:
        response - the gRPC describe collection response
        Returns:
        the SDK v2 describe collection response
